name: Camping Brugger am Riegsee
beschreibung: Camping Brugger am Riegsee is situated in the municipality of Murnau am Staffelsee in the Alpine foothills. The campsite directly borders lake Riegsee, providing access for swimming and boating activities. Amenities include pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as rental accommodation such as mobile homes and holiday apartments. The scenic landscape surrounding lake Staffelsee is perfect for hikes and bicycle tours. In Murnau itself, cultural attractions such as the Münter-Haus can be explored. A sanitary building and a kiosk are available on site. The convenient transport links allow easy excursions into both the Bavarian and Tyrolean Alps.
